verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a dedicated sandbox at demo.ramp.com and demo-api.ramp.com for building and testing "without affecting live production data". Demo accounts cannot move real money, and the sandbox includes simulation hooks for events. The CLI connects to the sandbox by default, and a demo MCP endpoint (demo-mcp.ramp.com) serves AI-agent testing. This is true environment isolation from production, not merely a dry-run mode. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the sandbox endpoints work as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: The Ramp sandbox is a testing environment where developers and partners can safely build, test, and experiment with Ramp's API without affecting live production data.
No real money movement: Demo accounts cannot process actual financial transactions
By default, the CLI connects to the Sandbox environment
